name: SEATEXT FREE Translation and Conversion Rate Boost
author: Seatext.com

sections.description:
🌎🤖🌊 100% FREE AI website translation in 125+ languages. No limits on pages, views, or languages! GPT-4 powered translations with context understanding. No OpenAI key needed.

✨ Core Features

🌎 100% FREE translations to 125+ languages (No limits!)
🤖 Powered by ChatGPT-4o technology
♾️ No limits on pages ♾️ page views or ♾️ languages (Everything is free!)
🔑 No OpenAI API key required

No limits! (Unlike Weglot, WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Loco Translate, qTranslate-X, GTranslate, MultilingualPress, Babble, ConveyThis, Transposh, WooCommerce Multilingual, etc.)

Universal Builder Compatibility: Seamlessly works with all major WordPress page builders:

🎨 Elementor (Free & Pro)
🎯 Divi Builder
🛠️ WPBakery
🦫 Beaver Builder
💨 Oxygen Builder
🎪 Brizy
📈 Thrive Architect
🎭 Visual Composer
⚡ Gutenberg
🧱 Bricks Builder
⚡ ZionBuilder
🎨 LiveCanvas

🛍️ WooCommerce Features

📦 Complete product page translation
📝 Product description localization
🔄 Variation translation
💳 Checkout process in local languages

PLUS 🚀 AI-Powered Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Seatext uses Amazon’s A/B testing strategy to optimize your website text and product descriptions for increased sales

PLUS Personalized Websites: Use data from Clay.com, your email, or CRM to rewrite landing pages for individual visitors

PLUS rewrite test for your mobile pages from their desctop versions (mobile adapation)

AI-Powered Website Localization

Smart Visitor Personalization: Automatically translates and localizes content based on visitor’s location, language preferences, and cultural context
Dynamic Content Localization: Adapts currency, date formats, units, and measurements to match visitor’s regional standards

Builder-Specific Translation Features

🎨Elementor Translation Features:

Translates and localizes all dynamic content into 125+ languages
Multilingual support for Elementor Pro popups and forms
Full localization of theme builder templates and global elements
Real-time translation of custom fields and dynamic text
Regional content adaptation for different markets

🎯Divi Builder Language Features:

Complete translation of all Divi modules and layouts
Multilingual support for dynamic content sections
Localized Divi theme builder templates for global markets
Regional content adaptation for different cultures
RTL language support for Arabic, Hebrew, and other RTL scripts

🦫Beaver Builder Localization:

Comprehensive translation of all builder modules
Multilingual Beaver Themer layouts and templates
Region-specific content adaptation
Cultural context preservation across translations
Local currency and measurement unit conversion

💨Oxygen Builder Translation:

Full language support for all Oxygen elements
Dynamic content translation and localization
Market-specific content adaptation
Cultural context-aware translations
Regional formatting for dates, numbers, and currencies

Additional Builder Support:

Complete translation of Visual Composer content
Multilingual Brizy blocks and popups
Localized Thrive Architect elements
Full language support for WPBakery Page Builder
Regional content optimization for all markets

Each builder integration includes:

Neural machine translation technology
Context-aware content localization
Cultural adaptation of content
Regional format conversion
AI Automatic language detection
RTL language support
Local SEO optimization
Market-specific content delivery (YES Cloudflare CDN network for translations for free)
Linguistic quality assurance
Translation memory integration

The first AI to actively improve your website’s effectiveness – for free!

sections.changelog:
3.0.3

  • Improved AI translation accuracy with enhanced context understanding.
  • Added support for additional languages in the translation engine.
  • Fixed bugs related to WooCommerce product page translation.
  • Updated compatibility with the latest version of WordPress (6.6.2).
  • Enhanced performance for faster translation loading times.
